portalsFound.observation: Korean Ministry of Land lists a free, unrestricted nationwide continuous cadastral polygon dataset, distributed as province/city SHP files in EPSG:5186. It reports 38,352,207 rows. Its own description says it is a reference map rather than legally authoritative survey data.
Ministry also catalogs a nationwide WMS/WFS continuous cadastral service; use requires an API application/key.
Official download destination did not return a parcel sample from this client.
